[h3][b][i]A game bundle about brewing drinks and talking with quirky characters[/i][/b]![/h3]

[h3][i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/i][/h3]
[b]Celebrating the release of Tavern Talk on 20 June, we decided to do "The Talking Bundle" collab, please do check it out![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/7dd1fb100448c9ea30038d04ce444d94da3aa02e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]About Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly[/b][/h3]
A direct continuation set a few years after the first episode. This is a heart-to-heart talking simulator where you interact with unique characters, including familiar faces from the first episode and new ones with their own set of challenges. Step back into the role of the Barista, serving drinks with new ingredients to mix and creating new, out-of-this-world coffee (and tea) recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/e96db2bede5aba4e650e4e35575c05c6bd6d189a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]About Tavern Talk[/b][/h3]
Gentle Troll Entertainment presents their latest game, Tavern Talk, a cozy visual novel about running a tavern in a D&D-inspired fantasy! Where the Coffee Talk series took place in a cafe in an alternate modern city of Seattle with fantasy characters, Tavern Talk took place in a tavern in a fantasy land called Asteria. Meet colorful cast of characters inspired from TTRPGs, serve them magical drinks, and meet adventurers on a life-changing quest.

Whether you want to serve a cup of coffee or mix magical drinks, we've got you covered in The Talking Bundle. In both Coffee Talk Episode 2 and Tavern Talk, you can always talk to your patrons and listen to their stories. Find your family among your diverse customers who aren't always human, and help them find a place that feels like home.

[h3][b]Grab the Talking Bundle here! [/b][/h3]

[i]The Talking Bundle discount is underway with the release of Tavern Talk until 4th July, 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/4493bc16d320ea1098530b8c2fafb5aaf3004727.gif[/img]

[h2]Happy 1st anniversary to Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly![/h2]

[h3][i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/i][/h3]
[b]In April 20th, we celebrate the release of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly after one year. Thank you everyone for your support until today. [/b]

Celebrating the one year anniversary after the release, we posted a short comic by the writer of Coffee Talk Episode 2 (also the creator of the comic), [url=https://twitter.com/junkipatchi]Junkipatchi[/url]. You can read the short comic and [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game/status/1781654196191903966]here[/url], or you can just read the comic below on this announcement. 

[h3]Page 1[/h3]
[quote=Page 1] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/357523ababee2d33e371ada59e56128061e5c644.jpg[/img] [/quote]

[h3]Page 2[/h3]
[quote=Page 2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/df4e7000e67c3fd5c6c4406ca443f30c778d38bd.jpg[/img] [/quote]

[h3]Page 3[/h3]
[quote=Page 3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/ce48808da07d2a5962a49f8ac269997c47c03cad.jpg[/img] [/quote]

[h3]Page 4[/h3]
[quote= Page 4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/7d9b191f6e438a5b34855b1ec48e8541f6f4a138.jpg[/img] [/quote]

Also, a short message from Junkipatchi, [url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game/status/1781654196191903966]originally posted[/url] on their account. 
[quote=Junkipatchi] From the start of Coffee Talk Ep 2's development, it was decided Freya wouldn’t be a regular—only Fahmi could write her. Fahmi's passing shook us so much that I asked to rewrite half the game to include [spoiler]the secret ending[/spoiler], and we decided to add Freya's appearance at the end. 

To us, Freya is Fahmi and Fahmi is Freya, so it only feels right to make this decision. For her future appearances, she will be around, probably like a satellite—because she's Barista's satellite, just like our beloved Fahmi was to the Coffee Talk franchise. 

We, the team, thank you for your support and understanding! 
Thank you for loving Freya, and Fahmi.[/quote]
Once again, thank you and all the regulars who have been following us all these years, from the first episode until now. There is no more remarkable achievement than knowing that you enjoy playing our games and love the characters and stories we create. [i]We look forward to seeing you again soon. [/i]

notes.title: Cofffee Talk Episode 2 x Makeship - Riona Plush
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/531c220dbd51e609e1a2f699309a412669ff2cdb.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]
[i][b]Riona plush campaign is now live. Check them out while you still can![/b][/i]

Just a chance encounter, her first visit to Coffee Talk was accompanied by a late-night city cop with a boisterous satyr. Riona, who initially appears intimidating due to someone's confident attitude, is a gentle and friendly banshee who also has a share of her problems. With the help of the other regulars with the barista, she's opening more and trying her best to achieve her dream of being a soprano.

It's the second campaign featuring the character from Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly. This fifth Coffee Talk and Makeship collaboration makes Riona an adorable plush.

[h2]The aspiring soprano with the Dreamin' Blue cup[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/05ba2d65122a8710dd7533d088cf054cd183397c.gif[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]
[i][b]Lucas plush campaign is now underway, for a limited time period![/b][/i]

The late-night Barista never sleeps, even on rainy days accompanied by thunder that could turn off the lights. It's the time when Lucas stopped by for the first time, and eventually became a regular at Coffee Talk. Lucas who originally never talked too much becomes really talkative when the vibes get into him. Sometimes too blunt and doesn't know his boundaries, but he still makes points and does care for people around him. 

It's the first campaign featuring the character from Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly. This fourth Coffee Talk and Makeship collaboration brings out the Lucas plush.

notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2 Workshop Released! Introducing the Characters Mod

[h2]Get creative with your favorite Coffee Talk regulars with the [i]Characters Mod[/i][/h2]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]
[b][i]The modding tool for Coffee Talk Episode 2 is now released.[/i][/b]

Have you wondered how your favorite characters in Coffee Talk look in different looks? We are happy to announce that our workshop support for Coffee Talk Episode 2 is now available. Now, you can access the modding tool from inside the game and the already existing localization and voice-over mod from the first title.

[h3]The workshop tool, with the new characters mod, is out now![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/c136232ca7e2e52479c9d35a960672be1b74e20f.gif[/img]

Coming from our previous title, Coffee Talk, we always look out to our fans and let them express their creativity towards our characters. This time, to spice things up a bit, we also include the new characters mod, where you can change your characters looks to your liking. You can check out our new documentation workshop from the link below. 

[h3][url=https://togepresskit.notion.site/Coffee-Talk-Ep-2-Modding-Tutorial-432ad3476b17475689743558fd1256f8]Coffee Talk Episode 2: Workshop Documentation[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/7790ec049e58687dd05ea60060d6a226de987ee8.gif[/img]
Just look at how Lucas seems so cool with a skeleton hoodie and dark sclera. 
[i]Yeah, we didn't intend this to happen. [/i]

[h3]Additional localization added.[/h3]
We are sorry for the delay, but now you can enjoy the additional localization of the Russian language to the game. We always listen to our fans and try to push out more updates. 

If you encounter any bugs or are looking for answers directly from us, please join our Discord community. You can also reach us from our social media to get the latest news of Coffee Talk updates. We will always serve more stuff that you can look forward to!

notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2 Devlog #2- Fantastic Arts (of Coffee Talk) and The Artists
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/8424835a7053e214e5ddfec4ca2fae05f1de8a25.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]
[b][i]Another scoop of with our crews featuring one of the artists behind the art of Coffee Talk.[/i][/b]

[h3]So, tell me, when you first think of Coffee Talk, what thing came to mind first?[/h3]

[i]To me, it’s the pixelated grin of Freya asking for (yet another) three shot Espresso. [/i]Then all the details of the cafe unwrap; the bar table, which Freya and the rest of the customers lean upon, then beneath it, all the cups and equipment probably only seen by the barista, and finally, the brick wall of the cafe and its ornaments, including the iconic “drown your trouble in coffee” sign hanging by the big window (which, did you know, is available as a T shirt?!). 

That memorable scene which we all adore is thanks to the art direction of Coffee Talk itself. [b]Dio Mahesa–the lead artist for the first Coffee Talk–made sure that the game incites a certain warm, cozy feeling you’d get from hanging in a cafe, with a sprinkle of nostalgic feeling thanks to the modern yet retro pixel art style.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/ec287b01eb70ec3e1f65205a99d470d3e29542ef.png[/img]

To know more about the art of Coffee Talk Ep. 2, what changes and the direction its taking, I’ve sat down with Dio and other artists responsible for making the sequel of our beloved game. So before we begin, prepare your warm cup of coffee, get comfortable, and please enjoy the interview!

[h3]1.) Is there differences in regard to art directions in the game, moving from Coffee Talk to Coffee Talk Ep. 2?[/h3]

[b]I think the biggest, and the most obvious change from the previous game is the colortone of the game, especially for the promotional art.[/b] We mainly use blue and yellow color tones for the art of Coffee Talk Ep. 2 to represent the new characters of the game itself, and to separate Coffee Talk Ep. 2 from its predecessor.

[h3]2.) So is it alright to assume that there will also be differences in the arts inside Coffee Talk Ep. 2 itself?[/h3]

[b]Of course! For starters, ]there will be more art collaboration with local talents from Indonesia, including Hendry Roesly, Kriswin Yuniar, Cairebell, Locoberi, and many more, as the late Fahmi–the creator of the first game–intended. [/b]

In Coffee Talk, we collaborated with local talents after the release of the game itself, as we put a dedicated section for collaborative arts in the game as the game updated. In Coffee Talk Ep. 2, we tried to put all those amazing arts made by the local talents in a more organic way that you will find out once you play the game. 

Speaking of collaborative arts, while it’s amazing to have tons of different artstyle from various artists, we asked them to follow the main direction of the art of Coffee Talk, which is the retro, anime style. So hopefully, all that will provide a diverse, yet coherent visual that players are familiar with.

Other than that, there’s also changes here and there in the setting of the game; the cafe. It’s subtle, but I hope the players will have fun finding all the little differences in the cafe between the first game and this one.

[h3]3.) That is very exciting to hear! And what about the characters in the game? Are they also going through changes, like the cafe?[/h3]

[b]Definitely. The time setting of Coffee Talk Ep. 2 is a couple years after the first game, so it is natural for them to go through changes. [/b]Like Junki mentioned, the overarching theme of Coffee Talk Ep. 2 is growth, and we want to emphasize that through the visuals of the characters as well.

We’ve shown some of the changes in the trailer, like how Lua now wears glasses and a new blazer. Every single character of Coffee Talk has changed here and there to show how they’ve grown during the time skip between the first and the second game. Some are subtle, while others might change so much you might not recognize them!*wink wink*

And just like the changes in the cafe, every character of the game has key visuals that we kept even with the changes, to keep the familiarity to the characters intact.

For example, Baileys, true to his namesake, has a certain element of Baileys (the drink) in his character, like how his shirt design is actually inspired by the drink. In the new game, we changed the brand of the drink we drew inspiration from, but the core element of “Baileys design is based on said famous drink” is kept intact.

We applied the same principle to the rest of the characters, so despite all the changes, they are still the same characters you know from the first game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/5f44b98cc33bec0bff6bf36a5f6bc0eb66827e0b.jpg[/img]

[h3]And that, dear customer, was the interview with Dio Mahesa, the art director of Coffee Talk Ep. 2![/h3]

So, which casts of the first Coffee Talk are you most excited to see again in Coffee Talk Ep. 2? Are you ready to find all the little changes in our beloved little cafe? Fret not, my friend, for the release of Coffee Talk Ep. 2 is very close upon us now!!

As always, thank you for coming, and I’ll see you again in your next visit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/c4cd10e1f45d854adf8eb93c57203d6892048e72.png[/img]

In the meantime, you can follow us on social media and join our community to get the latest information information about related events and announcements. It's just exactly a week before the release of Coffee Talk Episode 2, we're extremely excited to see your reaction and comments when the game goes live. Until then, see you next week when the game is released!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/c42b3f2e44ccb5b1dd82398e7c6875632e79bd0c.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]
[b][i]A special scoop from our crews, just a few weeks before the release of Coffee Talk Episode 2.[/i][/b]

Hey hey! Aul here, Human Resource Manager of Toge Productions, somehow ended up writing Toge Productions’ devlog. Why, you ask? Well, who knows... But I hope you’d stay and see through this journey of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly regardless!

Now, before delving into the topic indicated by the title of this news, here's a little anecdote about Coffee Talk and myself. I came across Coffee Talk during a sort of “Dark Night of the Soul” period in my life. I had just been made redundant by the previous company I was working for due to the pandemic, and like how we all were at that time, I was in a bad mental state when I stumbled upon the trailer of Coffee Talk for PS4 on Youtube.

At first, it was the lo-fi rendition of Clair de Lune that caught my attention. But soon I became captivated by the art and concept of the game. Being a coffee and café lover who got robbed of the pleasure of chilling in a coffee shop due to the lockdown, I immediately bought the game and fell in love as I delved even deeper into the story of Coffee Talk. The quirkiness of the character designs (I mean, to this day, Lua is still my video game crush of all time), their relatable stories, and the interactions I had with them was an experience that helped me through my bad time during the early pandemic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/6916659e4b5ffd299b90b33376ab9e79fb37db16.png[/img]

And fast forward a couple of years, with the help of the universe aligning my path with that of Toge Productions, here I am, sharing my stories with you and more importantly, the sequel of the game we’ve all played and hold dearly in our hearts! (Otherwise, you wouldn’t be here reading this, right? XD)

Now, as we all know, the most important part of Coffee Talk —being a narrative-driven visual novel—is its story. Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly have a high bar to clear in order to match its predecessor. So I sat with the game’s Narrative Designer and Lead Writer, Junkipatchi (or Junki for short) and asked her about all of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly’s story and narrative development.

Now finally, let’s hear from her in this interview with Junki!

[h3]1.) What is the Overarching theme of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly?[/h3]

[b]Although from the surface it looks like the theme of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly is ‘Social Media and the internet’, to me, the overarching theme of Coffee Talk Episode 2 is about ‘Growth’— which encompasses endings, beginnings, with all the goodness and pain it brings. [/b]The Social Media topic is, more or less, a catalyst for the actual theme– ‘Growth’– itself. [i]We also chose to incorporate both Social Media and the Internet as a part of the main theme because they're something that most of us have probably very used to, particularly during the pandemic.
[/i]
Speaking of the pandemic itself, however, we made a conscious decision not to include it in the game's storyline. This way, Coffee Talk can stay true to its calming and chill nature.

[h3]2.) How long does it take to write the story for Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly?[/h3]

[b]Oh wow, I guess the process itself started back in 2020 when Toge commissioned Kosmik to write a new character for (at that time) a Coffee Talk DLC, so, I guess, 2-3 year-ish?[/b] Hahaha.

As we were writing the Coffee Talk DLC, Toge realised the potential of the story, so they decided to expand the DLC plan from 5 days to 7 days long, and then our console publisher, Chorus Worldwide, proposed extending it to 9 days. We continued to keep expanding the DLC until they ultimately decided to go big and turn it into a full-fledged sequel…

And so, after the decision was made, it was only natural to expand on various aspects of the game, including new features. As a result, the story underwent another revision to ensure that it supported these new features and was cohesive both in terms of story and features.

[h3]3.) Is there any radical change from the first draft of the DLC to Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly itself? Characters that didn’t make it into the game, perhaps?[/h3]

Actually, yes! [b]Initially, a human character named Rhea was created for the Coffee Talk DLC, who was a "aesthetic wellness and health" social media influencer. However, as the game plan evolved, we decided to split Rhea into two separate characters.[/b] One of them is Lucas, the boisterous satyr influencer, who took on Rhea's influencer side and turned it up to the max. The other is Rhea, who was renamed to Riona, a banshee with a dream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/4749743c171ecbdc057d728f75701951ce4adcc9.png[/img]

The split allowed us to keep up with and play around with one of the core pillars of the Coffee Talk series, which is all about "Breaking the Stereotypes." For instance, Riona, as one of Banshees in Coffee Talk's alternate world, is ‘known’ for their terrifying wails and bad luck, but still aspires to be an opera singer anyway. Similarly, Lucas, a loud, slightly brash and vivacious satyr-influencer, may have his own layers that you'll gradually discover as you play the game ;)

[b]Other than that, there was also an incomplete concept of a dwarf character that was supposed to be included in the second DLC far in the future at that time. [/b]

However, Toge decided to add only two new characters for the sequel because we felt the need to explore more of the old friends from the first game and emphasise the theme of growth, showing how the passage of time affects everyone. That's why we pulled the brakes on new characters for now.

[h3]4.) Finally, as the writer for Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly, is there anything you want the players to be excited to find?[/h3]

The story "branchings" in Coffee Talk Episode 2 are probably more intricate compared to the first game, haha. [b]What I mean by that is that your favourite patron may have layers of thoughts on their situation, and there are more than a couple of ways to discover them, if that makes sense.[/b]
Additionally, there are plenty of world-building elements in the storyline that we hope will enrich the Coffee Talk universe in your mind, not to mention the return of old characters, ready to tell you what they've been up to. 

[i]We really hope all of the new elements, along with what we've cooked up for the game design (and everything else in between) will give an engaging experience that leaves a lasting impression for anyone who picks up the game.[/i]

Following up on the success of the first game was personally quite a daunting task, considering how special Coffee Talk is to many of its fans… but we loved writing it, working on it, and hope that we can meet everyone's expectations with this sequel!

[h3]And that, everyone, was the interview with Junki, the story writer for Coffee Talk: Hibiscus and Butterfly! [/h3]

Hopefully, this little interview will rouse your excitement for Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly. And if it hasn’t, then worry not! This interview is only the first part of a dev blog series that will cover other aspects of the game. I’ve interviewed everyone on the Coffee Talk team about their journey into making Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly, so just wait for what everyone has to say about the game!

Thank you for coming, and I’ll see you again on your next visit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/c4cd10e1f45d854adf8eb93c57203d6892048e72.png[/img]

In the meantime, you can follow us on social media and join our community to get the latest information information about related events and announcements. See you next week, when we will drop another devlog interview with another crew from Coffee Talk team. We are eager to see your comments about this devlog and the what's to come.
